channel.title: Netlify Blog
channel.description: The latest from the Netlify blog — product news, tutorials, and stories from the web platform.

item.title: 5x faster Edge Functions: v8 isolates to Unikraft MicroVMs
item.description: See how Netlify rebuilt Edge Functions on MicroVMs to deliver lower latency, greater reliability, and faster log delivery.

item.title: How we built Git storage for millions of Netlify projects
item.description: A technical look at how Netlify built Netlify Source: durable Git storage on S3, scalable caching, push consistency, and support for millions of projects.

item.title: Cursor Origin repositories build, preview, and deploy on Netlify
item.description: Cursor Origin repositories now build, preview, and deploy on Netlify — the same way GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket already do. Beta, via Cursor’s invite-only program.

item.title: Build with Netlify came to Atlanta
item.description: What happened when we brought Netlify to builders in Atlanta

item.title: Compete in OpenAI’s WebMCP Challenge with Netlify
item.description: Join the OpenAI WebMCP Challenge with Netlify. Build an agent-native web app with WebMCP and compete for $5,000 in prizes and 3 million Netlify credits.

item.title: New clarifying questions in Agent Runners
item.description: Netlify Agent Runners can now ask clarifying questions before they build, helping you get better results faster while saving time, iterations, and credits.

item.title: The full power of Git, without the friction: A conversation with Netlify CTO Dana Lawson
item.description: Netlify CTO Dana Lawson explains why Netlify brought Git infrastructure in-house, and what version control looks like in the age of AI agents.

item.title: Choosing an AI model: one prompt, 11 models, very different results
item.description: Netlify now runs any OpenRouter model, including Kimi K3, GLM 5.2 and DeepSeek V4. We tested 11 of them on the same build prompt to see how they differ.

item.title: Open models are having a moment. We’re all in.
item.description: Netlify now gives every customer access to leading open and commercial AI models through Agent Runners and AI Gateway, making it easy to build, experiment, and ship on production infrastructure.

item.title: Ask mode: consult an agent before making changes
item.description: Meet Ask mode for Netlify Agent Runners: a fast, genuinely read-only way to explore your codebase, query your data, investigate issues, and understand your project before making changes.

item.title: Open Weights and the 2nd World
item.description: The Berlin Wall taught me what it feels like to live behind a technological divide. As AI advances, we should be careful not to build a new one ourselves.

item.title: MCP goes stateless and extensible
item.description: The new stateless MCP spec makes building AI tools dramatically simpler. Learn how Netlify supports MCP 2026-07-28 today and why it matters for Agent Experience.

item.title: New Netlify projects are now private by default
item.description: Sites & apps on Netlify now start private. You can build, deploy, and preview as usual, but nothing is publicly accessible until you decide to make it public.

item.title: The 13-year story of Netlify Drop
item.description: Netlify Drop has offered anonymous drag-and-drop deploys since 2013 and pioneered the deploy-anonymously, claim-later flow AI agents use today

item.title: More headroom, a lower per-credit rate, and a bill you can predict: introducing new Pro plan tiers
item.description: New Netlify Pro tiers offer up to 20,000 monthly credits, credit rollovers, and predictable pricing for growing teams.

item.title: Netlify inside of Claude Design
item.description: Netlify and Anthropic have partnered to let you deploy directly to Netlify right inside Claude Design. No manual exports, no re-uploading. Design, deploy, and iterate all in one flow.

item.title: Netlify Functions, designed for Agent Experience
item.description: Netlify Functions update focused on Agent Experience, making them more discoverable, configurable, and interoperable with the modern JavaScript ecosystem.

item.title: How we measure Netlify’s Agent Experience
item.description: We built AXIS, an open source scoring framework for agent experience, and ran it on our own platform first. Here’s what the data showed and what we changed.

item.title: How to build a real-time AI chatbot in minutes with Netlify Agent Runners (no backend)
item.description: Build a real-time AI chatbot with Netlify Agent Runners using a single prompt. No backend setup required. Learn how to customize, iterate, and deploy instantly.

item.title: Tracking AI search traffic: how to use Netlify Log Drains to maximize AEO
item.description: Understand how AI crawlers interact with your site using Netlify Log Drains. Learn how to track AI search traffic and improve visibility for AEO in ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity.

item.title: How we built Netlify Database for AI-native development
item.description: Explore the thinking behind designing and building Netlify Database—a database that can be provisioned, branched, migrated, and operated safely in workflows shared by humans and agents.

item.title: My experience building and deploying a project with Netlify Agent Runners
item.description: Conor Martin shares his experience using Netlify Agent Runners to build, preview, connect an API, and deploy a travel blog with AI.

item.title: Agent Experience moves upstream
item.description: What Stripe Projects reveals about agents, setup, and production.

item.title: Netlify + Stripe
item.description: The Netlify integration for Stripe Projects lets developers and coding agents create or link a Netlify account, provision a new site, and deploy from the same terminal workflow used to set up the rest of their app.

item.title: Netlify Database is now available: from provisioning to integrated Postgres
item.description: Netlify Database is a fully managed Postgres database built into the Netlify platform. It brings professional branching and migration workflows into every project, so builders can move fast without things constantly breaking.

item.title: Netlify for Agents
item.description: Today we are launching our first website that is built for agents, not for humans.

item.title: The end of seats: pricing Netlify for 3 billion builders
item.description: Unlimited seats on Netlify Pro (including Git contributors)

item.title: Your code, your choice: Netlify’s stance on AI training data
item.description: At Netlify, we think the principle here is simple: your work belongs to you, and no one should train on it without your say-so.

item.title: You own your content
item.description: Netlify reaffirms its commitment to developers: you own your content. Learn how we protect your data, avoid selling your code, and ensure AI training only happens with your explicit consent.

item.title: Your builds just got faster. Here’s how.
item.description: Netlify has rebuilt its entire build infrastructure from the ground up. We have replaced our Kubernetes-based system with Firecracker MicroVMs. This new infrastructure is more than a speed boost; it’s a more secure, scalable foundation for the future of web development. It’s already handling your production traffic today at the same pricing and with zero work required on your end.
